summary: Linux proof of the SOLR-18616 bridge prototype: the feasibility test passes at the exact head (late-registered Jetty handler observes an unroutable request; counters and pool gauge round-trip through SolrMetricManager's Prometheus reader). The gate is filed failed on formatting only: tidy and spotless both require line-wrap reformatting of the prototype file, and the gate record requires a new pushed head and a new gate for any formatting change. Next step for the implementation worker: push the tidy fix as a new head; a short successor gate (prototype test, tidy, check) can then pass or fail on the mechanism's merits alone.
